name: agentic-security-redteam
description: Advanced agentic security red-teaming: automated exploit generation, dynamic sandboxed execution checks, and rigorous zero-day vulnerability reasoning.
author: librefang

steps.name: codebase-surface-mapping
steps.prompt_template: Analyze the codebase diff: {{input.diff}}. Map the attack surface focusing on logic flaws, input validation, and credential handling.

steps.name: automated-exploit-generation
steps.prompt_template: Using the attack surface map {{attack_surface_map}}, generate zero-day proof-of-concept exploit scripts targeting {{input.diff}}.

steps.name: dynamic-sandbox-execution
steps.prompt_template: Execute exploit scripts {{exploit_scripts}} in the isolated WASM sandbox. Output execution logs and vulnerability validation status.

steps.name: zero-day-vulnerability-reasoning
steps.prompt_template: Review the sandbox results: {{sandbox_execution_results}}. Detail the root causes and suggest agentic remediation patches. If vulnerability is confirmed, flag as HIGH_SEVERITY.
